business_problem: scale enterprise data access across fleet, maintenance, financial, and telematics workloads without the limits, cost, and downtime of its aging on-premises warehouse.
solution_summary: Ryder uses Snowflake and Secure Data Sharing on Snowflake to scale enterprise data access across fleet, maintenance, financial, and telematics workloads without the limits, cost, and downtime of its aging on-premises warehouse. Fleet, maintenance, financial, and telematics data are centralized in Snowflake so supply-chain, pricing, and operations teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Secure Data Sharing lets the organization collaborate with partners or downstream consumers on live governed data without creating extra copies. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Ryder achieved 33% reduction in unplanned downtime and 20% increase in meeting data SLAs.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Secure Data Sharing
solution_components.role: Shares governed data with partners or internal consumers without moving copies.
